name: MacWindowFrame
description: Decorative macOS-style window chrome that wraps showcase content such as code demos, screenshots, and portfolio pieces.

dense: Decorative macOS window chrome for showcase content: i18n titleKey, optional action button (actionLabelKey + onAction), density comfortable|compact. Presentation only — not a real window/dialog

usage.description: MacWindowFrame wraps showcase content — code demos, screenshots, portfolio pieces — in decorative macOS-style chrome. The title and optional action button come through i18n keys (`titleKey`, `actionLabelKey`). It is presentation, not a real window: the traffic lights are paint, and anything needing dialog semantics (focus trap, dismissal) belongs in Modal.

bestPractices.description: Use it to frame demos and screenshots where the desktop-app look sells the context.
Pass titles through i18n keys (titleKey), matching how the site renders all user-facing copy.
Use density="compact" inside dense grids of demos.
Provide onAction only when the button does something real; the button hides itself otherwise.
Do not use it as an actual window or dialog — Modal owns focus and dismissal semantics.
Do not rely on the traffic-light dots for any function; they are decoration and convey nothing to AT.
